surfaces.semanticRolesBody: Surface names describe a container's relationship to its substrate. They are the complete public API; components never select a numbered color or shadow.
surfaces.relativeNestingBody: Providers carry the current semantic substrate through ordinary DOM and portals. Floating content resolves upward when it opens inside an overlay, while its shadow keeps the same spatial meaning.
surfaces.shadowContractBody: Shadows express spatial separation, so Top reuses Floating rather than inventing a progressively stronger shadow.
